summary: Smoke test of the import of Website-Sekolah branch main27. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (login ok and invalid, /auth/me with and without auth, GET /settings /users /announcements /classes /gallery /face/students /subjects all return 200 with no _id in responses, create guru and siswa then GET then login then /auth/me then delete, siswa without phone returns 400). Frontend: /login loads; super admin logs in and lands on the dashboard; the sidebar pages Kelola Akun, Pengaturan, Informasi Sekolah, Absensi Barcode, Perpustakaan, Pengumuman and Schoolgram render with no JS page errors; public /galeri renders. Created a guru and a siswa through the Kelola Akun UI ('Akun berhasil dibuat' toast); both logged in and reached their role-specific dashboards. All test users were deleted afterwards.

issues: The sidebar has no 'Galeri' entry. The gallery is only the public /galeri page, reachable from the login page link. This matches the code; noting it because the review request listed Galeri as a sidebar menu.

The school logo box on the login page was empty in one screenshot. The school name showed as 'SMA NEGERI 1 LAGUBOTI' early in the session and as 'SMANSALA' later; GET /api/settings now returns school_name=SMANSALA. This is data-driven, not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8389 lines and should be split into routers (existing tech debt, out of scope for this import).
seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ users were created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super admin credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Siswa accounts need a phone number. Email, LiveKit and AI are unconfigured by design. Services restarted once mid-test and briefly returned a 502; it recovered by itself.
